notes.title: 2 Days Until Release !
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648571/26b5f850087a286ad9b9a9b37c1f3a64e4999443.jpg"]

We're excited to announce that our game will be released on Monday, September 15th.
The full story is available in the free(demo)  version.

The Donation Edition is for those who want to unlock Steam Achievements.
